title: Semantic Cache Correctness Lab
tagline: Measure when a similar question can reuse an answer and when it must miss.
summary: Build an opt-in answer cache that binds entries to tenant, model, source revision and expiry. Compare exact and semantic candidate matching using authored near-miss questions, including changed numbers and negation. Export a local HTTP adapter and a false-hit report; similarity alone must not authorize cross-user reuse.
youWillBuild: A tenant-isolated semantic caching layer, adversarial near-miss filter, and HTTP correctness report.
usefulFor: Prevent privacy leaks and hallucinated cache hits in multi-tenant LLM applications.
Block false semantic hits on critical near-misses such as changed dates, numbers, or negation.

languageWhy.Python: Standard-library data structures, cryptographic hashing, and text tokenization expose exact and semantic cache safety without third-party dependencies.

skills: Enforce tenant and freshness isolation boundaries
Implement exact cache lookup and invalidation
Export an HTTP caching adapter and correctness report
prerequisites: Basic hashing and vector similarity concepts

stages.title: Enforce identity, freshness and tenant boundaries
stages.summary: Structure cache entries with cryptographic keys binding tenant ID, model, source revision, and time-to-live expiration.
stages.languageWhy: Use explicit hash construction and deterministic standard-library dataclasses.

stages.title: Implement exact-match lookup and scoped invalidation
stages.summary: Build an in-memory cache store with exact lookup, expiry eviction, and bulk invalidation by tenant or source revision.
stages.languageWhy: Use standard-library dictionaries and deterministic iteration order.

stages.title: Evaluate semantic candidates against adversarial near-miss pairs
stages.summary: Score query similarity while detecting adversarial near-misses such as numerical changes, negation inversion, and entity divergence.
stages.languageWhy: Use standard-library tokenization, vector math, and regex pattern matching.

stages.title: Export a bounded HTTP adapter and correctness report
stages.summary: Connect the cache engine to an HTTP proxy adapter with audit headers and generate a false-hit, latency, and savings report.
stages.languageWhy: Use standard-library HTTP primitives and structured JSON reporting.
